rules.startIndex: random per session, persisted as lastFirst[pool]; new session must differ from previous first
rules.advance: cycle through pool in order from the random start; fanfare = one-shot random
rules.streaming: HTMLAudioElement progressive playback only (preload='none' until selected) — never decode/fetch whole files upfront
rules.ordered: pools listed in `ordered` open on their first track and cycle from there, ignoring the random-start rule
